mentions.name: Draftboard
mentions.description: This tool maps a user's professional network for fundraising, sales, partnerships, and similar goals to help them get introductions to people. It is currently in open alpha.
mentions.problem: Cold email is dying as it gets cheaper and easier to send emails with AI and automation, so human connection is going to skyrocket in importance.
mentions.audience: People seeking warm introductions for fundraising, sales, and partnerships.
mentions.source_excerpt: A tool to map your network - for fundraising, sales, partnerships, etc - to get intros to people.

evidence.value: A tool to map your network - for fundraising, sales, partnerships, etc - to get intros to people.
